newsitem.title: UK: Northern Electric up talk of rival bids.
newsitem.headline: Northern Electric up talk of rival bids.

text.p: Shares in Northern Electric Plc rose on Monday after weekend reports that the company could attract a rival "white knight" bid following last week's 630p offer from CalEnergy Co Inc.
The stock was up 7-1/2p at 638-1/2 by 0915 GMT in thin trade of just 31,360 shares.

The Independent on Sunday said Houston Industries was favourite to launch a rival bid while Entergy Corp, Florida Power and Light, Pacific Gas and Electric and Lyonnaise des Eaux were also possible bidders.
The Sunday Times said Northern believes a bid price of 700p was justified, partly because of the value of its stake in telecoms operation Ionica -- planned to be floated in New York and London.
A spokesman for Northern declined comment on the latest reports but said there had been no direct contact since the bid either with CalEnergy or with any other possible bidders.
The spokesman repeated the company's previous position that it would be prepared to negotiate on the basis of an offer of around 700p.
He said no date had yet been set for the release of the company's first-half results, originally due on December 5 but brought forward to the next two weeks following the CalEnergy move.
